instruction: Glitch is crashing. Have him jab the stimpak into his own arm.

target.reason: The page has no verb for using or injecting an item. Its verbs are depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, and refuse, and none of the allowed end states (holding an item, being in a room, or having said something) can express Glitch administering the stimpak to himself. Glitch already holds the stimpak, so 'holder' would not show the injection.
